key.name: save-history
key.description: Whether new copies are appended to the history file.

key.name: save-images
key.description: Whether image copies such as screenshots are stored as entries. Images carry no text, so without this they leave no trace at all.

key.name: max-items
key.summary: Maximum number of items to keep
key.description: When the number of unpinned entries reaches this size the oldest are dropped. Pinned entries do not count towards this limit and are never dropped by it.

key.name: toggle-menu
key.summary: Shortcut to toggle the history menu
key.description: An accelerator that opens or closes the clipboard history menu. Unset by default; assign one with: gsettings set org.gnome.shell.extensions.clipboard-history toggle-menu "['<Control><Alt>v']"

key.name: preview-length
key.description: How much of each entry is shown in the menu.
